entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally. I need to return this VeloBand sensor. It's not what I wanted, and I want my money back immediately.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your VeloBand. I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
The name is Mike Peterson. Order number is VF-8675309. Look, don't give me a runaround. I want a return label, and I want a full refund. Simple.

Thank you, Mike. I'm pulling up your order now. I see it was delivered on January 6th. To make sure I understand the situation correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

What does it matter?! It's my preference not to own it anymore! Your website policy says 90 days, I've had it for a little over two weeks. This isn't a negotiation, it's a return. Are you going to process it or do I need to speak to your manager?
There's no need for that, sir. You're right to ask about the return window. Please allow me just one moment to confirm the policy details for your item.

Okay, thank you for waiting. I've just reviewed the information, and you are absolutely correct. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can process this for you right now. My apologies for the extra questions.
Right. See? That's all you had to do. So what happens now?

I have just authorized the return in our system. I'm sending an email to the address on file right now. It will include a pre-paid shipping label and instructions. Just place the item back in its original packaging, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any mail facility.
And I'll get a full refund? No 'restocking fees' or other nonsense?
That's correct, a full refund to your original method of payment once our warehouse receives and logs the item. There are no fees.
Fine. That's all I needed. Threatening to post bad reviews online usually works.
I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mike?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
